conditioningInputsRecommended.purpose: Canonical individual/style and rose crown/gorget palette; keep full source canvas.
ONE selected airborne body/posture master for first wing transition batch; fix eye/beak/body registration in prompt.
Existing opposite wing pose as study/comparison only; do not silently blend two body masters.

nextBoundedBatchSuggestion.purpose: Fill missing real wing-stroke transition poses around ONE airborne body master; only request new purposeful poses, not another canon.
nextBoundedBatchSuggestion.count: Coordinator assigns2or3 distinct missing transition poses after biological-reference handoff; count follows motion need.
nextBoundedBatchSuggestion.beforeCall: Confirm airborne body/head scale once against canonical34worldpx perched width and head/bill proportions; select one shared source/output density for the new call, with room for full wing envelope.
nextBoundedBatchSuggestion.sourceConstraints: Stable full1024canvas or explicit whole-call native density conversion. No perpose silhouette fitting. Keep bill-tip and eye/body landmarks consistent; allow true wing articulation and minor drawn texture changes.
nextBoundedBatchSuggestion.reusedPoses: Existing up/down may be reused only if identity/body/anchor compatibility passes final-size playback; otherwise remain reference studies, never count them again.
nextBoundedBatchSuggestion.motionTruth: New wing drawings are wing motion. Runtime trajectory is actor movement, never extra drawings or proof of hover by whole-sprite sliding.
nextBoundedBatchSuggestion.timing: Choose readable visual wing-phase sampling with reviewer and runtime constraints; do not assert exact biological wingbeat frequency.

runtimeSeparation.wingCycle: Per-wing phase clock; depends on actual wing poses, not moving a single heldsprite.
runtimeSeparation.hoverBody: Stable body location with sparse purposeful corrective movement; no nonstop jitter or perpetual bob.
runtimeSeparation.dartBrake: Separate authored body-pitch/tail/wing braking poses plus finite actor acceleration/deceleration path; no generic idle-slide.
runtimeSeparation.backFromNectar: Face and beak relationship maintained while actor backs away; source backward-flight body/wing pose needed if silhouette changes; do not mirror a forward glide.
runtimeSeparation.nectarContact: Flower endpoint and bill anchor explicitly authored; approach, stable contact hold with wings, withdrawal. Target collision/offset requires Mac binding.
runtimeSeparation.perchLandingTakeoff: Wings/body keys plus feet extend to perch, explicit support-acquire/support-release transitions. Do not reuse airborne nonexistent ground contacts.

contractBoundary: Existing reviewTexture idle-only packet is for visual intake. Hover/feeding/dart/perch actions need Mac actor/physics/target contract handoff; no fake Sharp receipt or app binding.
remainingBiology: Corvid research worker handles supporting motion references in parallel. This prep does not invent an exact frequency or prescribe unsupported wing geometry.
generationAuthorization: No native call until root assigns after current checkpoint.
